added_models.model: Neuroendocrine CRPC patient-derived organoids and organoid xenografts (EZH2 inhibitor)

efficacy.model: Neuroendocrine CRPC patient-derived organoids and organoid xenografts (EZH2 inhibitor)
efficacy.note: Organoids from four CRPC-NE biopsies: EZH2 inhibitors GSK343/GSK503 had AR-independent single-agent activity at high doses, no synergy with enzalutamide; no NE-selected member trial.
efficacy.short: EZH2i active in CRPC-NE organoids, untested
efficacy.quote: These data suggest that EZH2 inhibition has activity in CRPC-NE and this does not require expression of the AR.
efficacy.confidence_note: Full text read via Europe PMC (PMC6008438, Nat Commun 9:2404, online 2018-06-19). Tool inhibitors GSK343 and GSK503, not a member drug; organoids OWCM154/OWCM155 vs adenocarcinoma MSK-PCa3; the matched PDOX kept EZH2/H3K27me3 but no in-vivo dosing is reported.
efficacy.judgement: Separate ex_vivo, patient-level track: patient-derived CRPC-NE organoids predict AR-independent single-agent benefit in neuroendocrine CRPC with no gain from adding enzalutamide, a different system and a different prediction from the Rb1/Trp53 GEMM (restored AR sensitivity). No member trial has enrolled or stratified NE/small-cell disease: ProSTAR (NCT03480646) and CELLO-1 (NCT04179864) were unselected mCRPC; zeprumetostat's NCT03741712 terminated 2019-09-30 at n=9 with no results; NCT04846478 (tazemetostat + talazoparib) is unselected with no results; the 2025-26 Hengrui trials NCT07230106 and NCT07407283 exclude neuroendocrine or small-cell histology. The comparison was never made.
efficacy.reason: No NE-selected trial of any member

considered_not_added: Member-specific CRPC cell-line / xenograft models: lirametostat (Constellation, Bradley 2018 AACR, unpublished) and zeprumetostat/SHR2554 (no peer-reviewed prostate model found on Europe PMC or Firecrawl; Hengrui's prostate rationale appears only as SHR3680 combination trials): same system as the draft's crpc-ezh2-xenograft track, nothing published to open a member-specific track.
Pten/Rb1/Trp53 lineage-plasticity GEMM (Ku 2017) and tazemetostat rat/monkey toxicology: already tracked in the draft.

N-Myc-driven NEPC models (Dardenne 2016 Cancer Cell; Berger 2019 JCI, doi 10.1172/jci127961): GEMM and engineered human prostate cells treated with EZH2 tool inhibitors; the same NEPC-sensitivity prediction as the Puca organoid track with no patient comparison for any member, so not opened as a third untested NEPC strip. Abstracts not re-read this run.

Later PDX / organoid lineage work with tool EZH2 inhibitors (Nat Commun 2024, doi 10.1038/s41467-024-51156-5; Nat Commun 2026, doi 10.1038/s41467-026-69308-0; Cell Rep Med 2026, doi 10.1016/j.xcrm.2026.103083): mechanistic, no member drug and no patient comparison; titles only, not read.
Mevrometostat (PF-06821497) models and trials: not a member of the reviewed class table; its draft entries are being dropped by adjudication and no mevrometostat-based track was opened.

Zeprumetostat's only mCRPC trial NCT03741712 (SHR2554 +/- SHR3680): terminated 2019-09-30 at n=9, no results posted, no admissible comparison on any track; NCT07230106 (2025) and NCT07407283 (2026) pair SHR2554 or tazemetostat with rezvilutamide in adenocarcinoma only ('no features of neuroendocrine carcinoma or small cell carcinoma'), no results.

In-silico dose models: the tazemetostat skin H3K27me3 Emax model (EC50 734 ng.h/mL) is fitted to patient data, not a preclinical model, and the FDA review contains no PBPK for CYP3A inducers (effect 'has not been evaluated'); CELLO-1's 1200 mg BID with enzalutamide came from its own phase 1b. No in-silico track.

ESMO 2024 CELLO-1 abstract 1603P (doi 10.1016/j.annonc.2024.08.1684) and the Constellation FY2020 10-K ProSTAR discontinuation: both belong to the existing crpc-ezh2-xenograft track (re-dating and patient_trials) and are left to the adjudicator.
Human genetic, human challenge and ex-vivo patient-cell sensitivity-versus-response models: none found for EZH2 inhibitors in prostate cancer.
